delivery.text: Actual transaction and spent output evidence flows through the existing observer into the comparator. The fixed Lean driver independently supplies expectations. One coder repairs the code while a separate reviewer checks committed milestones. The custody case uses a delivering fold. The witness, and the destination of a fold that delivers nothing, wait on the open model ruling; a delivered output booked without a datum is reported as it is, and holds acceptance until ruled.

boundary.text: Keep the repair in the existing live observation modules and their tests. Do not move modules or edit offchain, validators, Lean, shared configuration, or generated books.

verification-limits.text: Run existing tests and connected devnet cases. A fixture demonstrates observation behavior, not live validator acceptance.
